profile.summary: Specialties: ABAP, C/C++, Java, Linux, Python

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Architecting and optimizing software development environments through automation and containerization, streamlining both developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines for improved efficiency and scalability.
- Containerized complex software build systems, enabling flexible execution across disparate hosts, reducing infrastructure costs and improving build consistency.
- Transitioned system configuration management from golden disk images to Ansible roles, creating self-documenting, reproducible environments that streamline OS imaging and management.
- Automated environment configuration and software installation tasks, significantly reducing setup time for complex systems like Kubernetes and enabling users to self-diagnose and resolve configuration issues.
- Troubleshoot and resolve unforeseen complex configuration issues, including kernel panics and system lockups.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Linux · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Ubuntu · Kubernetes · Ansible · Gitlab · Jenkins · Gerrit · Cyberark · Podman · Docker · YAML · C/C++ STL · CMake

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Developed Ground Control Systems for unmanned aerial vehicles, working through the entire system lifecycle from requirements and UML design through test and delivery. Led small teams to deliver projects on time.
- Reduced software development and testing complexity by creating standardized environments using Docker and Vagrant with Ansible as a provisioner.
- Drastically decreased customer deployment issues by streamlining and standardizing software installation, leveraging Linux package systems (RPM and Yum).
- Developed and validated new software architectures, such as open mission systems, modernizing existing products and expanding the customer base.
- Supported high-profile customers, including NASA (Dryden Research Center) and the U.S. Air Force Special Operations Command.
positions.insights: Skills: C/C++ STL · GNU Make · Python · Ansible · Docker · Software Design · Vagrant · Technical Support · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Linux

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
- Developed financial systems software to bridge gaps in SAP’s standard solutions.
- Led small projects by breaking down work into accountable tasks and providing technical guidance to the team.
- Simplified a complex reporting system by implementing object-oriented design patterns, creating a - 
- Reduced run times of large jobs by converting single-process programs into multi-threaded applications, cutting execution time from three days to seven hours.
- Learned SAP architecture and ABAP programming to facilitate the transition from legacy systems to SAP.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · ABAP · SAP Implementation · Object Oriented Design · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed UAV flight software and support tools within an Agile SCRUM team, collaborating with physics, electrical engineering, and software specialists to meet system specifications.
- Reduced aircraft configuration complexity by developing a graphical aircraft configuration interface, allowing ground crew and engineering staff to quickly reconfigure aircraft.
- Simplified the software build process by updating recursive GNU make systems, enabling developers to focus on software development instead of troubleshooting build issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Agile Methodologies · Java · GNU Make · Apache Ant
